purpose: Determine whether the single WP3-MULTI-CAND-v2 spectral direction is an alternate feature representation of the known total-angular-momentum-squared function, without opening the publication reserve.
post_access_disclosure: WP3-MULTI-CAND-v2-RES-v1 lawfully accessed the candidate after its specification and implementation locks. Its result exposed that raw coefficient projection is not representation-invariant in a library with a 173-dimensional value-nuisance kernel. Exploratory diagnostics then found a candidate/L^2 value scale near -7.498053921436332. This corrected protocol is confirmatory, not blind discovery, and predeclares held-out and independent-precision tests before implementation.
evidence_boundary: A KNOWN_L2_FUNCTION_EQUIVALENCE result establishes only that the frozen numerical candidate and replicated rank-one directions evaluate as scalar multiples of the already known L^2 observable over the declared source and challenge domains. It does not prove a global symbolic coefficient identity, discover a new invariant, authorize publication-reserve access, or convert the original search into a bounded-null result. It requires a separately locked successor search that removes the observable L^2 equivalence class. An UNRESOLVED result preserves the original search as spectrally unresolved.

resolution_protocol.integrity: Verify every pinned prerequisite and byte-rebuild all four frozen source matrices.
resolution_protocol.training_fit: Fit one zero-intercept scalar from the candidate value response to the analytic L^2 value response using only frozen training weights.
resolution_protocol.held_scale: Hold the training scalar fixed for calibration and challenge value and Lie-response residuals; report independently fitted split scales only as a stability diagnostic.
resolution_protocol.backend_equivalence: Recompute the rank-one direction with NumPy SVD and SciPy LAPACK gesdd and gesvd, then compare centered observable response vectors, not coefficient representatives, on training, calibration, and challenge states.
resolution_protocol.physical_reference: Compute L^2 independently from sum_i q_i cross (m_i v_i), both in binary64 and from exact-rational challenge inputs with a source-disjoint mpmath implementation at 80 decimal digits.
resolution_protocol.known_direction_decision: Require the committed and every replicated response to satisfy the same held-out L^2 equivalence gates. Raw coefficient cosines are reported but are never gates.
resolution_protocol.reserve: Do not read, materialize, or execute any publication-reserve source row.

decision_policy.KNOWN_L2_FUNCTION_EQUIVALENCE: Every integrity, held-scale, backend-response, physical-reference, and independent-precision gate passes. Freeze a successor observable-known-quotient search before drawing a null conclusion.
decision_policy.UNRESOLVED: Any scientific equivalence gate fails. Preserve the original spectral candidate and open no reserve.
decision_policy.INVALID: Any prerequisite, lock, matrix-integrity, implementation, or reserve-integrity check fails.
